## Strategy

\[
M_d[r,B_d]-M_d[r,D_d]U_d^{-1}M_d[P_d,B_d]=0
\]
for every nonselected row \(r\).

Thus every row is an integral combination of selected rows. After ordering columns as \((D_d,B_d)\), unimodularity of \(U_d\) identifies the selected-row lattice with a graph over \(\mathbb Z^{D_d}\); an integral column operation takes it to \((I_{|D_d|}\;0)\). Hence the degree-\(d\) Smith data are \(|D_d|\) unit entries followed by \(|B_d|\) zero entries. The degree-\(4\) witness is \(M_4=0_{0\times1}\), \(D_4=0_{0\times0}\), \(P_4=\varnothing\), \(U_4=I_0\), \(\det U_4=1\).

This concerns \(i=j=p=c=2\), namely \(22\subseteq\lambda\subseteq4^4\), and only degrees \(4,\ldots,16\).
